name: Commander stax (taxes, untap denial, then Armageddon)
description: A Commander stax opponent: symmetric taxes and untap denial that they break with mana rocks, then a land wipe once they are ahead. Teaches playing under taxes: deploy cheap pieces before Thalia and Sphere, float mana before Winter Orb turns, and keep artifact mana so Armageddon does not end your game.

turns.boardSummary: 1 land, Sol Ring: the asymmetry starts now (their mana is rocks, yours is lands)

events.note: Stax decks run every rock they can: the locks are symmetric, the rocks are what breaks the symmetry.

turns.boardSummary: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben: your noncreature spells cost one more

events.note: Noncreature spells cost {1} more to cast for everyone. Creature-based lines are unaffected.
events.breakPoint: Decision point: cast your cheap noncreature enablers (signets, auras, removal) BEFORE turn 2 where you can; after Thalia every one of them is a turn slower.

turns.boardSummary: Sphere of Resistance: everything costs one more — two more with Thalia

events.note: Spells cost {1} more to cast. Stacked with Thalia, your two-mana noncreature spells now cost four.
events.breakPoint: Artifact and enchantment removal is at a premium here: one Nature's Claim on the Sphere buys back a mana on every spell for the rest of the game.

turns.boardSummary: Winter Orb: only one land untaps per untap step; their rocks keep untapping

events.note: As long as Winter Orb is untapped, players can't untap more than one land during their untap steps (CR 502.3, the untap step). Mana rocks are unaffected.
events.breakPoint: Decision point: from now on, tap lands for mana only when you will spend it; an unused land that stays tapped is a turn lost. Prefer spells that add rocks or treasure.

turns.boardSummary: Smokestack: each upkeep, they add a counter and everyone sacrifices permanents

events.note: Each upkeep its controller may add a soot counter; each player sacrifices a permanent per counter. They feed it tokens and spare rocks; you feed it lands.
events.breakPoint: Token makers and cheap fodder are the answer to Smokestack: sacrifice what costs you nothing, keep your lands and engine pieces.

turns.boardSummary: Armageddon: all lands destroyed; they still have four rocks

events.note: Destroy all lands. With Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and friends they keep operating; a lands-only mana base does not.
events.breakPoint: Decision point: if you saw Sphere and Winter Orb, Armageddon is coming. Hold a counterspell for exactly this, or make sure your win does not need lands after turn 6.

turns.boardSummary: They untap with rocks and a growing Smokestack; you have no lands. The game is decided unless your engine survived on the battlefield.

events.note: A 2/1 first striker is now a real clock, because nothing you have can be cast.
